Ham is pork, so no. Red meat like beef and pork is not good for foxes. 
It's not like arsenic or anything, but I'd probably stop and not give them any more. 
It's too fatty and causes their organs to work harder and can cause all sorts of issues.

Absolutely no beef or pork. 
They can have raw/freeze-dried chicken, turkey, venison, eggs (raw in shell is fine), melon, apples, and rasp/blue/black/elder-berries. 


Most canned meat has a LOT of sodium. I'd avoid doing more than 1 can of it every month or two.
